data.topic: iterative auto-fix loop skill for Claude Code CLI - patterns for building an automated issue resolution loop that handles UI visual regressions, compile errors, test failures, and lint warnings by repeatedly running checks, diagnosing issues, applying fixes, and re-validating until all problems are resolved
data.what: Iterative auto-fix loop skill that detects, diagnoses, fixes, and re-validates all error types (compile errors, test failures, lint warnings, UI visual regressions, runtime errors) in a unified loop
data.audience: Human users via /fix-loop slash command and other skills/pipelines (run-stories, ship) programmatically
in_scope: UI visual regression detection via screenshots
data.problem: No unified loop exists for iterating on fixes until all issues are resolved — coder agents run once and report, manual re-runs waste context and time
data.why: Coder agents hit errors, report them, and stop. The human has to re-run or manually fix. An auto-fix loop would let agents self-heal and converge to zero issues autonomously
data.end_goal: Zero issues — loop terminates only when all checks (compile, test, lint, UI) pass clean. Callable as /fix-loop by humans and programmatically by run-stories/ship pipelines
data.complexity_reasoning: Requires researching patterns from AI coding tools (Cursor, aider, Copilot Workspace) for automated fix loops, error categorization strategies, and screenshot-based UI validation approaches — external domain knowledge needed
